test_title: PYST 4: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

He had never seen (1)/ such a masterpiece (2)/ until he (3)/ visits the gallery last spring. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb tense used in **part 4**.
 
• The sentence begins with the **Past Perfect tense** ("had never seen") and refers to a specific past time frame ("**last spring**").
 
• The verb "**visits**" is in the Simple Present tense, which is inconsistent with the past context of the sentence.
 
• The correct verb should be in the **Simple Past tense** ("**visited**") to match the timeline.

Therefore, the correct answer is **4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He had never seen such a masterpiece until he **visited** the gallery last spring."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **(1) "He had never seen"** – This part correctly uses the Past Perfect tense to describe an event that happened before another point in the past.
 
• **(2) "such a masterpiece"** – This part is grammatically sound, using "such a" correctly before a singular countable noun.
 
• **(3) "until he"** – This is a correct conjunction used to show the point in time when the state changed.
 
• **(4) "visits the gallery last spring."** – This is incorrect because the present tense "visits" cannot be used with the past time marker "last spring."
